notes: Strong's own definition unifies this root's range as "to become clipped or (specifically) circumcised" -- qal "wither/fade/be cut down" (Job.14.2, 18.16, 24.24, Ps.37.2, of a flower/the wicked being cut off) and niphal "be circumcised" (Gen.17.11, the one form tagged under this exact number, 'c/5243 b') are both natively attested under H5243 itself, not borrowed from elsewhere.

Requested poel ("wither") and hithpoel ("be cut off") are NOT attested under H5243 -- the person's own "check if covered by H4135" instinct was right, but not quite in the way suggested: H4135 (מול, "circumcise") is a separate, unrelated-in-lemma root (not a suppletion partner needing strong_alt) that happens to independently carry both of these exact senses under its own numbers -- poel "wither" (Ps.90.6) and hitpael "be cut off" (Ps.58.8). Dropped from H5243 per "no uncited glosses"; cross-referenced here for visibility rather than modeled as strong_alt, since H5243 has its own complete-enough native paradigm and doesn't need forms supplied from H4135.
